主要内容: On March 22, 2013, SAP AG, a German-based company, issued a press release announcing that its Annual Report is now available and that its Annual Report on 20-F has been filed with the SEC. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The document includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update or revise these statements. The factors that could affect SAP's future financial results are discussed in its filings with the SEC, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 20-F.
